title: Can open source large language models be used for tumor documentation in Germany? - An evaluation on urological doctors’ notes

bias_targets.methodology: Using a balanced number of positive (containing tumor diagnoses) and negative (containing none) examples in few-shot prompts to evaluate whether the model systematically skews its predictions toward the predominant class.

Structuring few-shot prompts with unpredictable patterns of positive and negative examples (e.g., PN, PNNP, PNNPNP) to test whether models are disproportionately influenced by the final examples in the prompt sequence.

Comparing model performance when prompted with examples from the target domain (urology) versus a different medical domain (fictitious gynecology examples) to examine how well the models generalize task concepts without over-relying on domain-specific vocabulary.
